title: Watch Meadow, then leave
persona: A careful viewer with a remote who does exactly what they set out to do and nothing else.
goal: Switch to the Meadow channel, then use Leaving Home before going out.
success: Leaving Home put the calm channel back on: a banner says "Leaving Home — Naptime is on until you're back."

text: Leaving Home — Naptime is on until you're back.
